# Sprout AAC

> Free, open-source, offline-first AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) app for children with autism, cerebral palsy, and developmental delays. No subscription, no paywall, forever free.

Sprout exists because AAC devices and apps are prohibitively expensive ($149–$249+) and access to them is deeply inequitable — only 32% of minority families have AAC device access compared to 84% of white families, and the last widely-used free option (Cboard) moved behind a paywall in 2024. Sprout removes the cost barrier entirely while matching the customization and quality of paid AAC apps.

## Key facts

- Price: free forever, no subscription, no paywall, no ads
- Status: in active development, not yet released to app stores
- Platforms: iOS and Android (planned)
- License: open source, GPL v3
- Offline-first: fully usable with no internet connection; child data never leaves the device unless a family explicitly exports it
- Motor planning stability: symbol cell positions never move once set, by design

## Features

- Multi-child profiles
- Customizable symbol boards (3×3 to 5×5 grids)
- Native offline text-to-speech (no API key, no internet required)
- PIN-gated caregiver edit mode
- On-device word prediction (bigram model, per child, no data leaves the device)
- Planned: switch scanning, eye gaze support, Open Board Format (OBF) import/export, larger grid sizes, OpenDyslexic font
